counterfactual_missing_items: peripheral blood eosinophil levels were within the normal range
no history of urticaria, asthma, angioedema, or pruritus except for seasonal allergic rhinitis
decisive_items: marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils
developing asymmetry in the inner quadrant of the right breast
response.rationale: R3 directly matches the histologic hallmark of eosinophilic mastitis with chronic inflammation and no granulomas, while C1 only adds anatomical location without independent diagnostic support. R1 is weak because seasonal rhinitis alone does not explain the breast findings.

rejected.why: Only seasonal allergic rhinitis is insufficient to diagnose an allergic reaction; no systemic or local allergic evidence.
